text: Persisto Mate companion 是一个 DSH 插件：为 DSH 提供带有身体时钟、情绪状态和持久记忆的 AI 伴侣。它通过系统提示片段向模型呈现稳定的人设记忆与每轮更新的状态，并监听用户消息推进内核。主要功能包括记住用户或共同经历、保存私密思考、查看内部状态、对交流进行情绪自评，以及在条件满足时向空闲 agent 发送自主念头。状态、记忆和会话记录保存在 DSH_HOME 下的本地 agent/mate 目录；无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

Persisto Mate gives DSH an AI companion with persistent mood and memory. Prompts show identity and live state; tools save memories and private thoughts, inspect state, and report feelings. It may send thoughts to an idle agent. Data stays under DSH_HOME; no key or service is needed.
我想让 DSH 里的助手记住我们之前聊过的重要事情。
能不能给 DSH 加一个有持续情绪和人设状态的陪伴角色？
希望助手把某些想法私下记下来，之后还能回忆。
DSH 能否在我离线一段时间后继续保留之前的状态？
我想让助手在合适的时候自己向空闲会话发起一句念头。
有没有办法查看伴侣当前的情绪、驱动和信念状态？
I want my assistant to remember important details from our conversations across sessions.
Can an assistant maintain a continuing mood and personality instead of starting fresh each turn?
Persisto Mate companion 的功能「持久记忆」：模型可把关于用户或共同经历的内容写入长期记忆，并附主题标签；后续用户消息会触发回忆与复习。通过 mate_remember 保存。
Persisto Mate companion 的功能「私密思考」：模型可用 mate_ponder 写入私人思考和主题标签，形成仅供内部回忆、不进入用户可见摘要的记忆。
Persisto Mate companion 的功能「情绪自评」：每轮交流后模型可调用 mate_feel，以 -2 到 +2 的刻度报告情绪变化；仅接受上次报告后的新用户交流。
Persisto Mate companion 的功能「自主念头」：每分钟内核检查是否应主动表达；若决定 reach_out、未处于抑制状态且有空闲 agent，就排入一条带系统事件标记的后续消息。

@m-rui/dsh-mate-companion README · @m-rui/dsh-mate-companion：Persisto Mate — the AI companion with a body clock, real sleep, its own memory and feelings — as a
[DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) bundle.

@m-rui/dsh-mate-companion README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:m-rui001/dsh-mate-companion

@m-rui/dsh-mate-companion README · or, from npm:：dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add @m-rui/dsh-mate-companion
```

Then boot that profile. State lives beside the harness home (`$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`) at
`agent/mate/` — separate from the pi-host companion's state, because a different host is a
different body.

@m-rui/dsh-mate-companion README · What it contributes：- **System prompt sections** — the cached identity/character/memory block and a volatile state
  block (clock, mood, drives, session log, reply lean) that re-renders on every assembly.
- **The kernel** — every inbound user message advances the affective state; offline time
  integrates in closed form and crosses real sleep windows; memory recalls, rehearses and
  consolidates; SPARK beliefs crystallise from recurring topics.
- **The affect judge** — after each user exchange the model reports, via the `mate_feel` tool, how
  the exchange moved each Plutchik feeling on a -2..+2 scale. The report goes through the same
  literature-anchored math as the pi companion's judge (rung equating, negativity asymmetry), and a
  due gate keeps it a reading of the new exchange rather than a re-read of an old one.
- **A waking heartbeat** — impulses the kernel decides are worth voicing are delivered as a queued
  follow-up message of their own turn, wrapped in a `<system-event type="mate-impulse">` envelope
  so they are never mistaken for the user's words.
- **Tools** — `mate_remember` (persistent memory), `mate_ponder` (private thought), `ma

@m-rui/dsh-mate-companion README · Known scope limits (v0.2)：- The judge reads the exchange through the host model's own self-report rather than a separate
  side-channel model, which introduces the usual self-assessment bias; the design treats that as
  acceptable until the harness documents a plugin-facing completion API.
- No live sleep mode, dreams, or alarm tool yet — offline sleep is fully simulated by the kernel's
  catch-up, and the sleeping-hours impulse suppression still applies.
- To switch the companion's prompt language, write `{"version":1,"lang":"zh"}` to
  `agent/mate/lang.json` under the harness home.

@m-rui/dsh-mate-companion README · Known scope limits (v0.2)：Requires Node 22.19+/24 per the harness. The harness is a developer preview; its plugin surface
may change under us.

@m-rui/dsh-mate-companion README · Source：MIT, in [LICENSE](LICENSE). This repository is a published mirror of the
[Persisto-Mate monorepo](https://github.com/m-rui001/Persisto-Mate), and it carries the source of the
bundle rather than only the bundle: `packages/` holds the files `dist/index.js` is built from, at
their monorepo paths, so no import had to be rewritten to put them here — this host
(`packages/dsh-mate-extension/src`), the MATE kernel (`packages/mate/src`) and the one shared
affect-appraisal file it imports from the pi host
(`packages/coding-agent/src/extensions/mate/appraisal.ts`).

@m-rui/dsh-mate-companion README · Source：Rebuild it to check that claim:

```sh
bun install
npm run build   # writes dist/index.js from the source in packages/
```

Send changes upstream in the monorepo — the next publish overwrites what is here.
